browsers.name: chrome
checks: empty/partial pages and all 45 size/count combinations
bounded layout, last row/column, sticky aligned headers and exact mirror range
ten wheel boundary inputs on both axes and horizontal-strip vertical routing
keyboard scrolling, boundary containment and Tab escape
keyboard resize and toolbar/header sort agreement without false aria-sort
direction and category selection reset page and survive Back/Forward independently
failed save retains draft, blocks navigation, Retry/Cancel and focus restoration
rapid search/control commits one query, Back cancels pending debounce, no scroll reset
pending actions are inert; error Retry preserves URL and announces committed range
successive controls merge while a previous route is still pending
narrow/short/200%/400% equivalent widths, sidebar, dark and forced colors
repeated mounts and active resize unmount clean observers and drag listeners

limitations: Synthetic component fixtures, not authenticated admin routes or database adapters.
Native physical input, OS overlay scrollbar settings and manual screen-reader verification were not available.
